comments.body: this tarot (adv alchemy product, usually by-product of gold tarot production) is different than other tarot (usually from dungeons). This one has fewer negative tarots possible.

comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
This is the Alchemy Enhanced Tarot it has the same name as the standard one just with better Results. It has good results and cheap typically 10-25k each

The Only way to tell the difference between these cards is to buy one and keep it in your inventory. The Regular Tarot will not stack with this One thats how you tell.

NEVER EVER use the regular tarot it has tons of negative effects...You have been warned

The Outcomes of this tarot is..

Magician (Increases Production Success)
Strength (Recover from Conflict, Mutiny, and Sirens.Increase Loyalty when expired. )
The Emperor (Increase negotiation Success Rate)
The Star (Decrease Disaster Outbreak Rate)
The Hermit (Increase collecting trade goods while using Search,Collection, Procurement. )
The Hierophant (Recovers Vigor While Sailing)
